notes: CURRICULUM_PATH lesson 6: units V21 ◌ໍ, C14 ບ, T1 ◌່ (budget --max-units 3, as the path gives); core words W000009 may I have, W000003 not/question word, ແນ່ softener (newly drafted, unverified; the pool's ແດ່ W000308 is the alternative: native-speaker question); bonus W000049 home. Recycles W000031, W000018, W000019, W000020, W000011. If the lesson plays long, the ຂໍ … ແນ່ half can become its own lesson 7 (path note). ບໍ່ and ແນ່ are tagged function and never blanked. No tone-class explanations (decision 11).

summary_en: A new letter and a new vowel, two new words, and saying that something is good.
notes: CURRICULUM_PATH lesson 7: units C09 ດ (initial role) and V05 ◌ີ; core words W000002 good and W000016 this; bonus W000546 star and W000550 soil. Sentences: S000000004 ບໍ່ດີ (existing, unverified) and ດີແລ້ວ, ນ້ຳນີ້ດີ, ຂໍນ້ຳນີ້ແນ່ (composed, unverified). Recycles W000020, W000003, W000011, W000009, W001426. ນີ້ is tagged function (never an option; its slot may be blanked). No tone explanations (decision 11).

notes: CURRICULUM_PATH lesson 8: units C06 ສ, V01 ◌ະ, C08f ◌ຍ (final) and rule R01 (cut-off card, first drafted here; decision 25: one line, no rule to memorise). Recycles W000002, W000003, W000058. Flags: --max-units 3 --max-weight raised for R01.

summary_en: Two new letters, asking someone if they are hungry or thirsty, and answering.
notes: CURRICULUM_PATH lesson 9 (lessons 9 and 10 may swap: path note). Units C25 ຫ (h, initial role only; the silent ຫ before ນ ມ ລ is a later unit) and C05 ຈ. Sentences: S000002886 He is hungry, S000002887 Are you hungry? with reply S000002888 Not hungry, S000001170 Are you thirsty? (existing, resegmented ຫິວ + ນ້ຳ) with reply S000002889 Yes, I'm thirsty, S000000007 How are you? (existing). Composed sentences unverified. Recycles W000031, W000019, W000003, W000011, W000001. ເຈົ້າ tagged person|function (never a wrong option: polite yes particle).

summary_en: A new vowel, saying I and sleep, and the first full conversation: hello, are you hungry, I've eaten already.
notes: CURRICULUM_PATH lesson 10 (lessons 9 and 10 may swap: path note). Unit V22 ◌ອ◌ (same sound as ◌ໍ from lesson 6, used before a final letter). Core words W000006 I, W000033 sleep. Sentences: S000000113 I'm hungry and S000000008 I'm well (existing, unverified), S000002891 He's asleep already (composed, unverified). Target conversation as ordinary sentence items, contiguous and in order (PLAN S7g): S000000001 lines 1-2, S000002887 line 3 (repeated as 4b, listed once), S000002892 ຫິວ. line 4a (composed), S000002888 line 5a, S000002890 I've eaten already line 5b (composed; the payoff, last). Recycles W000072, W000019, W000018, W000020, W000001, W000031, W000005, W000003.

summary_en: No new letters: colour words, selling, and small, with sentences built from words you know.
notes: CURRICULUM_PATH lesson 11 (no new letters; bonus words become core). Core words W000536 colour, W000538 white (bonus in L0004, now core), W000539 black, W000084 sell (bonus in L0008, now core), W000090 small (bonus in L0010, now core), W000218 glass (bonus in L0005, made core so ຂໍແກ້ວນ້ອຍແນ່ can be used). Six words: over the --max-words 5 path flag by one (budget warning). Built as one lesson with a colour block and a sell/small block; the owner may split it there after play-testing. Sentences, all composed (unverified): S000002893 ສີນີ້ຂາວ, S000002894 ສີນີ້ດຳ, S000002895 ສີນີ້ດີ, S000002896 ລາວຂາຍເຂົ້າ, S000002897 ຂໍແກ້ວນ້ອຍແນ່, S000002898 ແກ້ວນີ້ນ້ອຍ. Colour sentences are ສີ + ນີ້ + colour word (no compound rows). ເຂົ້າຂາວ (S000002875) not used: the owner doubted it in lesson 4. ດຳ and ຂາວ added to the personal-name exclusions (Dam, Khao). Recycles W000016, W000002, W000031, W000019, W000009, W001426.

notes: CURRICULUM_PATH 'After lesson 11' row 1 (ມ opens ມີ, ມາ). Owner 2026-11-14 approved the proposal: four new words (ມີ ມາ ບໍ່ມີ ແມ່ນ), bonus ສ້ອມ 'fork' for the final ມ. summary_en: No new letters: every Lao word has a melody, and two words with the same sounds can differ only by melody.
notes: PLAN L3 / CURRICULUM_PATH lesson 13 (owner 2026-11-18): the tone lesson. Rules R05 (tone table: ເຂົ້າ/ເຂົ່າ only, marks called out; owner 2026-11-19), R07 (ມາ/ມ້າ, before horse) and R06 (recap, decision 18: one mark ◌້, two melodies, ເຂົ້າ vs ນ້ຳ); core words W000724 knee and W000562 horse, each a tone twin of a known word (the planner adds the tone-pair listening questions after each card once both words are recorded). (existing, unverified), S000002923 I'm at home, S000002924 (It's) here (composed). S000002924 is a line of the outing conversation (lesson 18).
